provenance.source_hash_method: Input set: sorted repository-relative non-test .go files, go.mod/go.sum and migrations/sql/*.sql, tracked plus untracked nonignored. Hash stream: for each UTF-8 filename append its8-byte unsigned big-endian byte length, then filename bytes, then32 binary SHA256(file bytes) bytes; SHA256 of the resulting stream.

embedded_artifacts.hash_method: Same filename length/name/binary-file-SHA stream as source hash; input set is all contracts/api/v2/embed.go selected artifacts and web/dist regular files.

recipe.scope: GPU paired cohorts; software checks use the production software handler recipe.

method.readiness: Monotonic interval from before actual playback API POST through three fully fetched nonempty TS bodies.
method.statistics: Medians and observed sample ranges; paired differences computed per round.
method.warmup_outside_timing: Hardware capability initialization; mode settle 2.25s legacy/17s standalone; no claimed cold-cache control.
method.capacity_scope: Sequential latency pilot; planner capacity excluded.
method.tls: Fresh trusted test CA and URL-host validation; wrong CA/hostname rejected before HTTP; no HTTPS-to-HTTP fallback.
